TaskState.description: Canonical Task states plus recovery-related Task-level substates explicitly permitted by Section 9.11.

AgentType.description: Section 10.3 defines these five reference AgentType values and permits implementation-specific extension types. Therefore the schema intentionally does not close the string domain.

AgentState.description: Appendix E.11 references AgentState but the frozen specification does not define a closed canonical AgentState enumeration. This schema intentionally preserves it as a non-empty formal identifier.
